editFields.label: Edit Fields
editFields.description: Map fields for each item and optionally retain its existing fields.

splitOut.label: Split Out
splitOut.description: Split an array field into individual items with optional parent fields.

aggregate.label: Aggregate
aggregate.description: Collect all items or selected field values into one item.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Keep the first or last configured number of items.

sort.label: Sort
sort.description: Order items by typed fields with deterministic tie and null handling.

removeDuplicates.label: Remove Duplicates
removeDuplicates.description: Keep the first item for each matching value in this execution.

filter.label: Filter
filter.description: Pass only items that meet all or any configured comparisons.

switch.label: Switch
switch.description: Route each item through named comparison outputs and an optional fallback.
